subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

My mother said / that Ben will done / the assignment / today.
solution:
The correct answer is "**that Ben will done.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the error lies in the part "that Ben will done." 
 
• **The verb 'done' is in the wrong tense.**
 
• It should be 'do' or 'will do'.
 
• **Since, the sentence is in future tense. We will use the formation "will+ do."**
 
• The correct sentence would be "My mother said that Ben will do the assignment today."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: 'today' is an adverb and is placed correctly in the sentence. -
 
• Option 2: 'My mother said' is a complete and correct phrase. -
 
• Option 4: 'the assignment' is a noun and is placed correctly in the sentence.
